paper_title: dKV-Cache The Cache for Diffusion Language Models

model_annotation: The graph illustrates the relationship between GSM8K Accuracy and Cache Ratio for two different conditions: "No Delay" and "Delay". The x-axis represents the Cache Ratio, ranging from 0.2 to 0.5, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis represents the GSM8K Accuracy, spanning from 0 to 80, also with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 20. The "No Delay" line is depicted in blue with a solid style and circle markers, while the "Delay" line is shown in green with a solid style and square markers. The "No Delay" line starts at approximately 72 on the y-axis when the Cache Ratio is 0.2, and decreases to around 7 when the Cache Ratio is 0.5, with notable points at (0.3, 68), (0.4, 60), and (0.45, 30). In contrast, the "Delay" line remains relatively stable, starting at around 72 when the Cache Ratio is 0.2 and staying near this value until the Cache Ratio reaches 0.5, where it is still at approximately 72, with intermediate points (0.3, 72), (0.4, 72), and (0.45, 72).

model_annotations.English: This plot illustrates the relationship between cache ratio and GSM8K accuracy for two different scenarios. The x-axis, labeled "Cache Ratio," has a linear scale with values ranging from 0.2 to 0.5, and tick labels are spaced at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis, labeled "GSM8K Accuracy," has a linear scale with values ranging from 0 to 80, and tick labels are spaced at intervals of 10. The plot contains two lines: a blue line representing "No Delay" and a green line representing "Delay." The blue line starts at approximately 70 and decreases to around 5, exhibiting a sharp decline between cache ratios of 0.3 and 0.5, passing through points such as (0.3, 60) and (0.5, 5). The green line remains relatively stable, starting at around 75 and ending at approximately 75, with minimal fluctuations across the cache ratio range.
